svg.title: A strategy proposes its next parameters and cannot adopt them: one real run
svg.desc: RSI on 2026-10-12. The declared grid of six periods and two directions, shaded by mean rank IC: the row registers reversion with period 14 and the search picks momentum with period 28. The registered gate, check by check: every observed value clears its threshold, and the alternate after costs does not object. The same search on the 16 names the provider answered adjusted, without the 12 it only has no corporate action on record for, is refused: its interval spans zero. Registration starts scoring on later sessions only; none is scored yet, and the row keeps its parameters until it is edited.

text.tspan: CLAWOCK · A STRATEGY THAT SEARCHES ITSELF
It may propose its next parameters. It cannot adopt them.
One real run, drawn as it came out: RSI on 2026-10-12.
Mean rank IC, 771 sessions, 28 names. All 12 trials counted.
Bars adjusted: yes. An alternate can object, not pass.
The same search without the names one provider vouches for
An edge interval across zero is no edge: the candidate rests on those 12 names.
What registration starts, and where it stops
